intro: Slovakia is a small country with strong folk traditions, a large Hungarian minority and a mostly Catholic population.

chapters.title: People
text: Bratislava and Košice are the largest cities. Slovak, closely related to Czech, is the official language. Hungarians make up a large minority in the south, and Slovakia has a sizeable Roma population, many of whom face poverty and discrimination.
Folk music and dress remain alive; the fujara, a long shepherd's flute, is on UNESCO's heritage list.

chapters.title: Faith
text: Most Slovaks are Roman Catholic, and religious holidays such as Christmas and Easter are important family occasions.

keyTerms.meaning: A people with origins in India who have lived across Europe for centuries.
